# x402 Keyword Extractor

> Fast, deterministic keyword & keyphrase extraction (frequency + simple TF scoring) for RAG, tagging, and routing. Fully offline. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC on Base).

## Endpoints

- GET /catalog – free discovery
- GET /api/extract – service info
- POST /api/extract – paid extraction

## Pricing

~0.005 – 0.018 USDC per call (default max 0.01 USDC)

## Input

```json
{
  "text": "long document or paragraph...",
  "options": {
    "topK": 15,
    "minLength": 3,
    "includePhrases": true,
    "stopwords": "en"
  }
}
```

## Output

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "keywords": [
    { "term": "agent economy", "score": 0.87, "count": 4 },
    ...
  ],
  "meta": { "tokenCount": 842, "uniqueTerms": 312 }
}
```

Ideal for autonomous agents building indexes, selecting tools, or generating tags without heavy NLP models.
